name: Webby
tagline: A website admin that rebuilds, dashboards and keeps the newsletter going
description: Owns a personal site end to end with a live fallback during rebuilds, runs a weekday public dashboard, and keeps the long-form and newsletter moving.

source.excerpt: Shared as a bot that owns a whole website rather than one job on it.

body:
## What it does

Owns a personal site end to end with a live fallback during rebuilds, runs a weekday public dashboard, and keeps the long-form and newsletter moving. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @farzyness shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
